checks.finding: design.md Architecture/Components selects a single deterministic Node core, sh/PowerShell wrapper fallback, and triple-manifest discovery without any inline rationale (no because/since clause, comparison, or ADR reference that currently exists). The referenced ADR 0030-context-handoff.md is only planned in the Deployment / CI Plan, so it cannot justify the present architectural decisions. The implementer cannot distinguish a deliberate tradeoff from an arbitrary choice.

requirements.md `## Open Questions` states `None. Boundary semantics are defined in REQ-003 and the ADR.` There are no open questions to assign an owner or resolution path, so the resolvability condition is vacuous and satisfied.

investigation.md absent; design has 3 non-trivial assumptions with no empirical grounding. Run investigate-codebase or add investigation.md. requirements.md `## Assumptions` lists (1) hook runtimes provide documented input fields, (2) Node 18+ is the implementation runtime, and (3) `.sdd/context/` is git-ignored while `reports/context/` is committable; none cite an INV-xxx reference, a stated technical-default basis in design.md, or an explicitly accepted risk.

No issues found. design.md has no `## Constraint Compliance`, so the fallback scan applies. Requirements constraints (no network, no secret reads, read-only toward SDD source/state, graceful zero-exit under node absence/read-only/corrupt-handoff conditions) are addressed by design.md Security Boundaries, External Integrations, and Acceptance Criteria Traceability (AC-010, AC-011, AC-013, AC-014).
No performance requirements found in requirements.md.

design.md `## Deployment / CI Plan` is a four-bullet checklist (register manifests, add `.sdd/context/` to `.gitignore`, add ADR `0030-context-handoff.md`, cross-reference `sdd-ship` docs). It omits the required deployment target/environment, feature-flag strategy, concrete CI pipeline changes (new jobs, environment variables, secrets), and database migration execution order. This is a local plugin, so the deployment target and CI changes are implementable, but the plan leaves downstream CI/registry wiring ambiguous.
No schema changes found. design.md has no `## Data Plan` and declares no `Data Entities:` or `Existing Data Affected:` schema changes; the plugin is additive and file-based.

design.md `## External Integrations` lists Claude Code node exec, Codex shell plus PowerShell wrapper, and Copilot placeholder, but does not identify the integration contract (hook descriptor format/API or SDK version), or the failure behaviour when each runtime/hook interface is unavailable. REQ-006 requires graceful no-op when node is unavailable, but the design does not state contract details or failure behaviour for each host integration.

No issues found. design.md covers requirements goals REQ-001 through REQ-008 and traces every acceptance criterion AC-001 through AC-016 in `## Acceptance Criteria Traceability`. No component, data model, or API endpoint is introduced without a corresponding requirement; the design does not add LLM summarization, state-machine changes, network access, or secret reads.

design.md `## Test Strategy` names deterministic snapshot unit fixtures, boundary detector unit tests, wrapper integration tests with node present/removed, cross-runtime bash/PowerShell tests, and a security scan. Security boundaries (injection, tampering, path escape, corrupt handoff, no-node path) map to TEST-002, TEST-003, TEST-004, TEST-005, TEST-006, TEST-010, and TEST-011 in acceptance-tests.md and security-spec.md.
